subject: SI Immersion — Field Ops Enablement & Deployment Lab
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amita Shah <amita@compass-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SI Immersion — Field Ops Enablement & Deployment Lab

Hi Amita,

Thanks again for the productive call earlier this week. As discussed, we'd like to run a two-day SI Immersion for the Compass field engineering and delivery leads to accelerate first deployments with Redwood Dedicated and the private VPC option. The goal: have a delivery-ready pilot by the end of the engagement and a repeatable runbook your consultants can carry into customer projects.

Draft agenda attached (SI-Immersion-Agenda-v2.pdf). High level:
- Day 1: architecture, security posture, network & KMS integration, sample deployment (hands-on)
- Day 2: performance tuning, batching/caching configurations, failure-mode drills, handoff checklist

Logistics / asks from your side:
- Confirm attendee list (recommended 6–8 engineers: 2 architects, 2 deployment engineers, 2 PMs)
- Provide a point of contact for network/VPC access tests (we'll need temporary test VPC peering or sample config)
- Confirm whether you want the lab in our hosted dev cluster or in a Compass-managed cloud account (we can send a cloud environment checklist)

Proposed dates: July 23–24 or Aug 6–7 (flexible). Please review the agenda and share any additions you want prioritized.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Partner Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SI-Immersion-Agenda-v2.pdf (13 pages)
From: Amita Shah <amita@compass-consulting.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Compass Consulting Partnerships <engage@compass-consulting.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SI Immersion — Field Ops Enablement & Deployment Lab

Evelyn —

Really appreciate the rapid draft. The agenda looks solid and aligns with what the delivery leads requested. A few notes from our side:

- Attendees: confirmed list below (we'll send full calendar invites after dates are set):
  - Amita Shah (Practice Lead)
  - Sameer Patel (Cloud Architect)
  - Nina Morales (Delivery Engineer)
  - Cole Ramsey (Platform PM)
  - Priya Joshi (Security SME)

- Environment: we prefer to run the hands-on labs in a Compass-managed AWS account (for parity with customer runs). Can you send the environment-checklist so our infra team can prep?
- KMS: Priya will need the HSM/KMS requirements doc up front; she flagged cross-account KMS policies as something we'll want to validate during the lab.
- Outcome: strongly agree with the runbook objective. Would like to add a short session on change management and customer enablement collateral (templates).

Dates: Aug 6–7 works best for the team. Please lock those if that works for you.

Thanks,

Amita Shah
Practice Lead, Cloud & AI | Compass Consulting
T: 617-555-2416

Date: Mon, 03 Jul 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI Immersion — Field Ops Enablement & Deployment Lab (dates confirmed)

Amita —

Great — Aug 6–7 is locked on our side. Updated plan below and a few action items to make the two-day lab high-impact:

Updated outline (attached):
- Day 0 (pre-work): Compass infra team completes environment-checklist.xlsx and shares IAM/KMS contact details; Redwood sends test VPC peering template.
- Day 1: Secure deployment walk-through, KMS integration test, first pilot spin-up (hands-on)
- Day 2: Performance profiling, tuning suggestions, failure injection & rollback drills, handoff + collateral templates

Action items: 
- Compass: upload completed environment-checklist.xlsx to the shared Drive by Jul 20
- Compass: confirm the name and email of the KMS admin for cross-account policy work
- Redwood: provide a pre-lab runbook template (we'll attach runbook-deployment-template.docx) and a brief troubleshooting checklist

Attachments included: environment-checklist.xlsx; runbook-deployment-template.docx

If that works, we'll send calendar invites and a short pre-lab read that includes a list of sandbox accounts and a link to the drive.

Thanks — excited to get this into the field.

—Evelyn

Evelyn Hart
Partner Programs Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: environment-checklist.xlsx; runbook-deployment-template.docx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Amita Shah <amita@compass-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI Immersion — Field Ops Enablement & Deployment Lab — logistics & runbook

Looping in a few quick logistics notes and a lightweight runbook primer before we finalize the Drive folder: 

- Runbook scope: we'll include a one-page customer-facing checklist, a deployment step-by-step for the SI (with common commands), and an escalation matrix (who to call on infra, networking, or model regressions).
- Lab infra: for Compass-managed accounts we recommend the t3.medium-equivalent for control plane steps and g5.2xlarge for the single-node performance testing; we'll provide Terraform snippets in the Drive.
- Pre-lab test window: we can run a dedicated VPC peering test on Jul 27 (30 min) — please confirm if the Compass infra team can be available.
- Photo/notes: we'll capture a whiteboard photo and the final runbook draft in the Drive after Day 2.

Attachments to be uploaded to the Drive by Jul 15: runbook-deployment-template.docx, Terraform snippets (infra-snippets.zip), quick-failure-checklist.md

Thanks — will update the HubSpot deal with these dates and the pre-lab checklist.

-Aditya

Aditya Rao
Manager, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0132
